about_the_game:
Bible Trivia – Wisdom DLC

Step into a deeper dimension of knowledge and spiritual insight with the Wisdom DLC — your complete in-game Bible and study companion, designed for reflection, learning, and growth.

📖 What’s Included in This DLC


✅ In-Game Bible Access: Instantly read multiple versions of the Bible in 6 languages — English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, German, and Chinese.
✅ Verse-by-Verse Note System: Add personal notes to any verse while you read.
✅ Smart Reference Tool: Missed a quiz answer? Instantly open the Bible to see the full context and learn directly from the source.

🌍 A Deeper Learning Experience


This DLC transforms Bible Trivia into a powerful study tool. Whether you're a casual player, student of theology, or a Bible enthusiast, Wisdom bridges gameplay and Scripture like never before.

📝 Key Features


  • Multi-Version Bible Library: Read and compare translations for deeper understanding (KJV, NIV, Reina Valera, Luther, Louis Segond, and more).
  • Personalized Notes: Highlight key verses and write reflections as you read.
  • Quiz Integration: Learn from your mistakes — access relevant Bible passages right after wrong answers.
  • Offline Access: No internet needed — everything is available in-game, anytime.

📌 Requirements


🔹 Requires the base game "Bible Trivia" to access this additional content.
